licence.scope: No owner statement found. Checked https://www.superwasp.org/, /about/, /vespa/data-releases/ and /privacy-policy/ (all HTTP 200; they carry funding acknowledgements and a cookie/privacy policy but no copyright or licence terms), and https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/SuperWASPMission.html (HTTP 200; asks for an acknowledgement but states no licence). https://wasp.warwick.ac.uk/ gave no response. info.json gives no page URL, only the cited reference Pollacco et al. 2006 (bibcode 2006PASP..118.1407P). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
